description_en: Invoke the DescribeRCInstanceAttribute API to query the details of a single RDS Custom instance.
description_zh: 调用DescribeRCInstanceAttribute接口查询单个RDS Custom实例的详情
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-rc-instance-attribute --instance-id rc-dh2jf9n6j4s149260000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --private-ip-address 192.168.XXX.XXX --max-disks-results 20 --instance-name k8s-node --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeRCInstanceAttribute

parameters.help_en: The VPC network IP address of the instance, that is, the private IP address.
parameters.help_zh: 实例的VPC网络IP地址，即私网IP地址
parameters.name: private_ip_address

parameters.help_en:
Set the upper limit for the number of instance disks in the return result. The valid range is 10 to 500.  
If no value is set, the default value is 20.  
If the set value is less than 10, it is fixed to 10.  
If the set value is greater than or equal to 10 and less than or equal to 500, the set value is used.
parameters.help_zh:
设置返回结果中的实例磁盘数量上限，取值范围为10~500。
未设置值时，默认值为20。
设置值小于10时，传入的值固定为10。
设置值大于等于10，小于等于500时，以设置值为准
parameters.name: max_disks_results
